## Argument

All facts quoted from the primary working context WORKING-5ea5e1ab7e82cc26 are its Established facts or SHA-pinned reusable computations; candidates are treated as unproved and none are used. Steps are labelled [proved], [source-backed], [computational], or [gap].

### Scope and scoping decisions

The theorem is deliberately fibre-level. Two primary constraints shape the statements: (a) a global splitting W = W_4 + W_5 over the universal balanced tetragonal base is NOT available from fibrewise balancedness (balancedness supplies only the relative Harder-Narasimhan filtration), so the block-minor identity in Step 2 is scoped to geometric points and to opens on which a splitting is chosen; (b) scheme-theoretic equality of the CE determinantal/Fitting ideal with the Abel-Jacobi incidence ideal is NOT concluded from geometric-point agreement, so Step 5 states only equality of reductions/geometric points, citing the dependency C66-GEO-Z.

### Step 1 - Bundle ranks and the 26->12 evaluation [proved]

At g=6 the CE degree formula gives deg(W_5) = 4*6+12-4*5 = 16 and deg(W_4) = 4*6+12-4*4 = 20 (pinned sha b66575be..., 6a2af9f6...; established fact). Both exceed 2g-2 = 10, so fibrewise H^1(W_f) = 0; by cohomology and base change, pi_*W_f is locally free of rank h^0(W_f) = deg(W_f) - g + 1, i.e. ranks 15 and 11, and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change (established fact). Since W_f is a line bundle on C and Gamma is finite locally free of degree 6, pi_*(W_f|_Gamma) is locally free of rank 6. Hence phi = phi_4 + phi_5 has source rank 15+11 = 26 and target rank 6+6 = 12, and Fit_0(coker phi) is the ideal I_12(phi) generated by the 12x12 minors (established fact).

### Step 2 - Block-minor identity [proved, scoped]

Over a geometric point (or any splitting open) W ~= W_4 + W_5 and phi is block diagonal. A 12x12 minor selecting k columns from the first block has rank at most min(6,k) + min(6,12-k), which is < 12 unless k = 6; when k = 6 the minor factors as a 6x6 minor of phi_4 times a 6x6 minor of phi_5. Therefore I_12(phi) = I_6(phi_4) * I_6(phi_5) on that open, and in particular at every geometric point (established fact, column-selection rank bound). This is the only point where a splitting is used; no global splitting is claimed (constraint respected).

### Step 3 - The f=4 block is surjective: I_6(phi_4) = O_S [proved]

Fibrewise, coker(phi_4) = H^1(W_4(-Gamma)); its Serre dual is H^0(omega tensor W_4^dual(Gamma)), a line bundle of degree 10 - 20 + 6 = -4 (pinned sha a23562a7..., 0a749db7...; established fact). A negative-degree line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has no nonzero section, so coker(phi_4) = 0 on every geometric fibre. Since pi_*W_4 and pi_*(W_4|_Gamma) are locally free with base-change-compatible formation (Step 1), fibrewise surjection implies I_6(phi_4) = O_S. Combining with Step 2: I_12(phi) = I_6(phi_5). Thus the entire evaluation-obstruction ideal is the maximal-minor ideal of the W_5 evaluation alone.

### Step 4 - Base change and universal Pic^0 pullback [source-backed]

Fitting ideals commute with arbitrary scalar extension, and twisting an evaluation map by a line bundle pulled back from the base does not change its Fitting/maximal-minor ideal (established facts). For L_univ = omega(Gamma_P) tensor Poin^{-1} of relative degree 16 on C x_S Pic^0(C/S), one has R^1 p_* L_univ = 0 (relative degree 16 > 10), p_* L_univ locally free of rank g+n-1 = 11, and the universal evaluation Phi commutes with arbitrary base change (established fact; pinned sha 04163aba..., 39e5a7c0...). The W_5 evaluation matrix is the ordinary underived pullback of Phi along a_N even when a_N is not flat (established fact). Hence formation of I_6(phi_5) commutes with arbitrary base change.

### Step 5 - Geometric fibre of the rank-drop locus [proved at geometric points; reductions only]

At a geometric fibre C_s, I_6(phi_5) vanishes iff rk(phi_5) <= 5 iff coker(phi_5) = H^1(W_5(-Gamma)) != 0 iff (by Serre duality) H^0(omega tensor W_5^dual(Gamma)) != 0. This line bundle has degree 10 - 16 + 6 = 0 (established fact; pinned sha 0a749db7...), and a degree-zero line bundle on a smooth projective connected curve has a nonzero section iff it is trivial, i.e. iff O(Gamma) ~= L_s := W_5 tensor omega^{-1} (established fact). This set is exactly the fibre of the Abel-Jacobi map Sym^6(C_s) -> Pic^6(C_s) over [L_s], namely the complete linear system |L_s| ~= P^{h^0(L_s)-1}. On the balanced locus with fibre divisor D_s, W_5 ~= omega^2(-D_s), hence L_s ~= omega(-D_s) and the condition is Gamma in |omega(-D_s)|, equivalently D_s + Gamma canonical (established facts). Only equality of geometric points/reductions is asserted: (Z_ev)_red = I_red as reduced closed substacks, which is the content of dependency C66-GEO-Z (ATT-0048, confirmed by REV-0091 and REV-0092, as mirrored in the primary working context). Scheme-theoretic equality is explicitly NOT claimed (constraint respected).

### Step 6 - Exact fibre-dimension bounds [proved]

deg(L_s) = 16 - 10 = 6, so chi(L_s) = 6 - 6 + 1 = 1 and h^0(L_s) = 1 + h^1(L_s) >= 1 (established facts; pinned sha dc9dcf85..., 04163aba...). By Serre duality h^1(L_s) = h^0(omega tensor L_s^{-1}) = h^0(M_s) with M_s := omega^2 tensor W_5^dual, and deg(M_s) = 2*10 - 16 = 4 (pinned sha b81f0e4d...). If h^0(M_s) = 0 then h^0(L_s) = 1. If h^0(M_s) >= 1 then M_s is special because h^1(M_s) = h^0(omega tensor M_s^{-1}) = h^0(W_5 tensor omega^{-1}) = h^0(L_s) >= 1; Clifford's theorem gives h^0(M_s) <= deg(M_s)/2 + 1 = 3. Therefore 1 <= h^0(L_s) <= 4 and dim Z_ev(C_s) = h^0(L_s) - 1 lies in {0,1,2,3}. This proves the fibre-dimension part of the theorem; the packet's pinned Clifford computation is thereby upgraded to a two-sided bound with the specialness check supplied.

### Step 7 - The equality case h^0(L_s) = 4 [proved, new]

h^0(L_s) = 4 iff h^0(M_s) = 3, i.e. M_s is a g^2_4. First, a g^2_4 on a genus-6 curve is base-point-free: a base point would leave a g^2_3, and a base-point-free g^2_3 gives a degree-3 morphism to P^2 whose birational image is a plane cubic of geometric genus <= 1, while a non-birational degree-3 map has image a line and gives h^0 <= 2; both contradict genus 6 with h^0 = 3. So M_s gives a base-point-free degree-4 morphism C_s -> P^2. If it were birational, the image would be a plane quartic of geometric genus <= (4-1)(4-2)/2 = 3 < 6, contradiction. Hence the map factors with degree >= 2 through a curve mapping to P^2; since deg = 4 and the image cannot be a line (h^0 would be <= 2), the map has degree 2 onto a conic ~= P^1. Thus C_s is hyperelliptic and M_s = 2g^1_2 (equivalently, the standard Clifford-equality case for a special degree-4 divisor that is neither 0 nor canonical). Consequence: on the balanced locus, h^0(omega(-D)) = 4 can occur only over hyperelliptic fibres. Whether such fibres lie in the balanced tetragonal locus, and whether h^0(omega(-D)) = 3 constantly there, remain open (frontier obligation; see GAP-CONST).

### Step 8 - Expected-codimension bookkeeping [computational; no image claim]

For a map of vector bundles of ranks 11 -> 6, the expected codimension of the locus {rk <= 5} (vanishing of maximal minors) is (11-5)*(6-5) = 6. This matches the pinned computation that for ranks k, k-1 the locus {rk <= k-3} has expected codimension 3*2 = 6 (sha 9dca9077654d...). Inside the relative Sym^6 of fibre dimension 6, expected codimension 6 is consistent with the Abel-Jacobi fibre being cut by 6 conditions. Separately, the naive source count dim Hurwitz = 15 (pinned sha 5257b07e..., 7668e8f4...) plus fibre dimension h^0(L)-1 <= 3 gives source dimension <= 18, and 17 if h^0(L) = 3 (pinned sha 9316384d...), i.e. naive codimension 4 in dim M_{6,6} = 21. Per the primary constraint, a source-dimension count does not determine generic fibre dimension, image dimension, component purity, stabilizers, or closure behavior; accordingly NO unconditional image-dimension or codimension claim is made (this is exactly the ATT-0063 Part (G) deficiency flagged in TASK.json notes). The discrepancy expected 6 vs naive 4 is recorded but not converted into a nowhere-lci conclusion either (constraint respected).

### Step 9 - Reduced-support nonemptiness caveat [proved caveat]

chi(L_s) = 1 forces the full Abel-Jacobi fibre |L_s| in Sym^6 to be nonempty, but the unique effective divisor could be non-reduced (e.g. 6p), in which case the reduced-support open and the ordered Conf_6 incidence are empty (primary constraint). Therefore nonemptiness is claimed only for the full Sym^6 fibre; the reduced-support/ordered locus is open in |L_s| (complement of the relative discriminant) and possibly empty. No nonclosedness of the balanced image is asserted either (constraint respected).

### Blocked routes and constraints addressed

None of the four blocked routes (vcd-only-vanishing; undecorated-cgp-top-weight-graph-complex; point-count-without-degree-parity-separation; forgetful-map-renaming-local-system-unknown) is used: the argument is a fibre-level determinantal/linear-series computation and uses no vcd vanishing, graph complex, point counts, or forgetful local-system identification. Addressed primary constraints: (1) parameter count 15+2=17 is not used to assert generic finiteness or pure codimension-4 (Step 8); (2) chi(L)=1 is not used to assert reduced-support nonemptiness (Step 9); (3) geometric-point agreement is not upgraded to scheme-theoretic ideal equality (Step 5); (4) fibrewise balancedness is not upgraded to a global splitting (Step 2 scoping); (5) expected-vs-observed codimension is not used for a nowhere-lci conclusion (Step 8); (6) openness of balancedness/nonemptiness is not used to assert nonclosedness (Step 9).

### Gaps

GAP-IMG: actual image dimension, generic fibre dimension, stabilizers, component existence/purity, closure and codimension of Z (and Z^bal) in M_{6,6} are undischarged. GAP-CONST: constancy h^0(omega(-D)) = 3 on the balanced locus is open; this artifact restricts values to {1,2,3,4} with 4 only hyperelliptic, leaving exclusion of values 1,2 and of hyperelliptic balanced members unresolved. GAP-SCHEME: Fitting-ideal vs Abel-Jacobi-ideal scheme equality open. GAP-SPLIT: global splitting open. GAP-READ: see evidence limitation below.

theorem_statement: Theorem (determinantal rank-drop ideals and fibre dimensions at (g,n)=(6,6)). Let pi:C->S be a smooth proper family of genus-6 curves over a locally noetherian characteristic-zero base S, with a relative effective Cartier divisor Gamma finite locally free of degree 6, carrying a balanced tetragonal Casnati-Ekedahl structure with summands W_4, W_5 (fibre degrees deg(W_4)=20, deg(W_5)=16). Then: (i) R^1 pi_* W_f = 0 for f=4,5; pi_*W_4 and pi_*W_5 are vector bundles of ranks 15 and 11 whose formation commutes with arbitrary base change; pi_*(W_f|_Gamma) is locally free of rank 6; the combined evaluation phi = phi_4 + phi_5 is a map of locally free sheaves of ranks 26 -> 12 and Fit_0(coker phi) = I_12(phi), the ideal of 12x12 minors. (ii) At every geometric point of S, and over every open on which W splits as W_4 + W_5, I_12(phi) = I_6(phi_4)*I_6(phi_5); phi_4 is fibrewise surjective (the Serre dual of its cokernel has degree -4), hence I_6(phi_4) = O_S and I_12(phi) = I_6(phi_5). No global splitting over the universal balanced base is asserted. (iii) Formation of I_6(phi_5) commutes with arbitrary base change; phi_5 is, up to twisting by a line bundle pulled back from the base (which does not change Fitting/maximal-minor ideals), the underived pullback along a_N:S->Pic^0(C/S) of the universal evaluation Phi of L_univ (relative degree 16, R^1 p_* L_univ = 0, rank p_* L_univ = 11). (iv) On a geometric fibre C_s, the zero set of I_6(phi_5) in Sym^6(C_s) is exactly {Gamma : O(Gamma) ~= L_s := W_5 tensor omega^{-1}}, i.e. the Abel-Jacobi fibre |L_s| ~= P^{h^0(L_s)-1}; on the balanced locus with fibre divisor D_s one has L_s ~= omega(-D_s), so the failure condition is D_s + Gamma canonical. Equality with the Abel-Jacobi incidence is asserted only on geometric points/reductions ((Z_ev)_red = I_red, dependency C66-GEO-Z / ATT-0048); no scheme-theoretic equality is claimed.
